description: Counts business days between two dates on a joint calendar: days after start up to and including end (inclusive=true also counts start). Negative if end is before start. Lists weekday holidays in range. Max 10 years. Deterministic, no AI. Price: $0.001 USDC per call via x402 (Base); the first 5 calls per day per client are free.

calendars.description: Comma list of calendars; a day is a business day only if open in all. XNYS (NYSE), FED (Fedwire/FedACH), TARGET2 (EUR), UK-ENG. Aliases: NYSE, US, ACH, EUR, UK. Default FED.

inclusive.description: true to count the start date too

name: business_days_between
title: Count business days between two dates
